turns.question: Which kind of customer call left people happiest in September 2026, and in what share of those calls?
turns.answer: Product calls left people happiest: 75% of the 16 labelled product calls in September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) ended with a positive mood, a model-derived label; delivery, pricing and returns returned no positive-sentiment share for that period. Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
